verdict.rationale: LangGraph core is a pip-installable open-source library (langgraph-gh-5) with a CLI to build and run the Agent Server locally (langgraph-docs-23, langgraph-docs-30, langgraph-docs-37), and supports production-grade self-hosted persistence via PostgresSaver (langgraph-docs-13), confirming a fully self-hostable core product outside any managed SaaS. missing for 10: explicit license/self-hosting infra docs (scaling, containerization) and independent hands-on confirmation of self-hosting beyond CLI docs.
